sources.title: New research confirms negligible LeTID degradation in TOPCon solar cells
sources.excerpt:
US researchers have found that light- and elevated-temperature-induced degradation (LeTID) has a limited impact on n-type TOPCon solar cells compared with earlier p-type PERC technology. Optimized firing conditions and laser-enhanced contact optimization (LECO) can further suppress degradation, with industrial TOPCon cells showing efficiency losses within acceptable warranty tolerances.
